output.content: I handle the hyperparameter tuning for the weekly retraining cycle by hand. I pick the learning rate and batch size values myself, then run each configuration on the cluster one by one. I check the validation loss in a spreadsheet to see which setup works best. There is no script that loops through a grid of options automatically. I adjust the parameters for each specific article and store group based on what I have seen in previous runs.
